newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London static, await earnings news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London static, await earnings news.

text.p: U.S. stocks were at a virtual standstill on Tuesday as European investors awaited upcoming corporate earnings and economic data, dealers said.
"It is very quiet this morning. People are nervous about the Dow's level and want to see if current earnings justify the market rating," one senior dealer said.
"It's a good excuse to do nothing."

Major U.S. companies are due to report quarterly earnings over the next few weeks. Chip maker Intel, up $3/8 at $147-1/4, is scheduled to release first-quarter figures after Wall Street's close this evening.
U.S. retail sales and inflation numbers, due at 1330 GMT/0830 EST are also keep many participants on edge, dealers said.
US consumer prices for December are forecast to rise by 0.3 percent in December while retail sales for the month are seen up by 0.5 percent, according to a Reuters poll of economists.
The March T-bond future was up 3/32 at 110-16/32 while the March S&P 500 futures contract eased 0.15 to 764.10 by 1100 GMT.
